deterministic_rule: 1 Preserve the initially selected forty slots; prohibit substitution after a slot is exposed to MAIN Grammar analysis.

2 Before first MAIN scientific transaction, replace only on publisher original PDF/complete-HTML original accessibility or unreadable decisive model material, paper/model noneligibility, published correction material ambiguity, proven exact or central-family collision, or failure of preregistered lane/family diversity.

3 For each affected slot, scan its backup_priority in listed order. Skip DOI selected in any MAIN or current/future G1 PILOT, any identified direct derivative central-family duplicate, any incomplete/unverifiable original edition, or a backup lacking a completely explicit source-native mechanistic model.
4 If a backup is shared by multiple strata, process slots in canonical manifest order and allow that DOI only once; later slots skip it.
5 If same-rank independently eligible backups exist, select earliest sorted lexicographic canonical DOI, not predicted reconstruction outcome.

6 Prior published source correction may require explicit one fixed corrected version; alternative manuscripts are ineligible absent separate authorization and model-content equivalence; no standalone supplements required unless original itself makes them defining.
7 Record every candidate rejection, DOI collision, correction, source retrieval failure, cross-lane unresolved G1 candidate reservation and owner decision in append-only events.
8 Unfilled backup queue or unresolved conflict prevents FINAL_FROZEN; remain WORKING or READY_FOR_JOINT_FREEZE conditional.
9 No replacement based on predicted or observed H0/H1/H2, reconstruction difficulty, coverage, Grammar residual or fidelity.
notes: Backups are prospective leads, NOT preadmitted sources. B2 blocked tags never bypass collision screening.
